summary: You take 20 units of graduate Psychology courses (numbered 200 and above, cross-listings included), each letter graded with a B- or better; a course not offered for a letter grade does not count.

program.why: "All courses counting toward the PhD minor must be taken for a letter grade and passed with a B- or better grade. If the course is not offered for a letter grade, it cannot be counted toward the PhD minor."

OmSgFcrO.why: "the student must complete 20 units of coursework at the graduate level in the Department of Psychology. Crosslisted graduate courses can be used to satisfy this requirement. All courses counting toward the PhD minor must be taken for a letter grade and passed with a B- or better grade." Graduate level is read as numbered 200 and above, the numbering of every graduate course the department's MA and PhD text lists; a cross-listed graduate course counts through its PSYCH listing. The audit otherwise lets an S count in a course offered only S/NC, so the PSYCH graduate courses offered only S/NC are excluded from the pool.
